claim_scope: In-domain model-boundary effectiveness and recovery robustness. Full view is entity-held-out only; a retrospective result-blind family-clean sensitivity view removes train/dev provenance-family overlap. Neither is template-level or out-of-domain generalization.

split_proof.empty_curated_asset_collection: allowed for synthetic-only seed rows and reported
split_proof.nonempty_curated_asset_identity: all identity/family fields required or fail_closed
split_proof.family_clean_filter: Block a whole test seed when any result-blind provenance-family key occurs in train or dev. Prefer (source_record, source_id, source_record_id); otherwise use (asset_fallback, source_id, asset_type, asset_id).
split_proof.source_record_family_overlap: reported; the full 4200-row view is ENTITY_HOLDOUT_ONLY
